answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one anchor weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 24 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 243 times the capital for one share. The velvet report makes public the merge explicitly at each saffron. A farm of 2473 identities would post 4579 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
